limitations: Warm server/storage, tvOS simulator, representative approved H264 show/movie only.
Metadata and artwork prefetch only; no full-media prefetch or RAID writes.
Decoded statistics and presentation opportunity are observations, not hardware/GPU fences.
Per-video http counter excludes SDK metadata, PlaybackInfo, reporting and uninstrumented stream/preview requests.
The prior opt04 had three TV starts; opt05/06/07 have four including the longer reporting lifecycle.
Opt05 server capture covers the first long lifecycle and some later TV activity; it does not cover the full client profiling run.
Opt06/07 have no independent server capture.
Failed pre-session catalog spans, rejected dismissal status requests and synchronous audio-session warnings remain disclosed.
Excluded MPEG4/AVI and zero-numbered episode cases remain unresolved; broad Swift 6 target migration is incomplete.

server_lifecycle.provenance: Independent maintenance-chat observer; scoped successful session queries, earlier opt05 executable only.
